name: Kursk Open 2017
information:
Registration will be closed at midnight on September, 6 or when we reach 100 competitors.
Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. 
Registration fee:
* **FREE** for any one event (for ex. Rubik's Cube only);
* **100 RUB (~2 USD)**  for equal or less than 12 events;

If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please [contact us](mailto:g.sloboda@mail.ru,Lexkov27@gmail.com) to resolve the issue.

Visit the competition [website](https://vk.com/kurskopen2017) for more details.
